title: Lanthanoid “Bottlebrush” Clusters: Remarkably Elongated Metal–Oxo Core Structures with Controllable Lengths

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: dysprosium bottlebrush cluster Dy19-A (monoclinic crystal form)
list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: [Dy19(1-3H)(1-2H)11(CH3CO2)6(OH)26(H2O)30] (core formulation shared with Dy19 series; co-ligand/packing variant)

material_class.structural_family: rod-like bottlebrush cluster of apex-fused Ln5O6 trigonal bipyramids

synthesis.procedure: Bis-tetrazole calixarene 1 was dissolved in ethanol or 1:1 ethanol:ethyl acetate with 1 equiv of the lanthanoid metal salt. A 1 M aqueous ammonium acetate solution was added to adjust the calixarene protonation state (instead of triethylamine). The solution was allowed to evaporate under ambient conditions, depositing crystals after 1–2 weeks. Varying the metal:calixarene ratio (2:1, 1:1, 1:2, 1:3) still deposited the Dy19 cluster; increasing the relative amount of acetate altered crystal packing (Dy19-C) rather than cluster nuclearity.

reagents.name: bis-tetrazole calixarene 1
reagents.amount: 1 equiv relative to metal in the standard procedure; metal:calixarene ratios 2:1, 1:1, 1:2, and 1:3 also used

reagents.name: ammonium acetate
reagents.role: carboxylate coligand / base to adjust calixarene protonation

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals deposited from the evaporated ethanol or 1:1 ethanol:ethyl acetate solutions after 1–2 weeks and were used for single-crystal X-ray diffraction.

properties.summary: Magnetic measurements in the main text are reported for Dy19-B, not specifically for this crystal form.

material_class.structural_family: rod-like bottlebrush cluster of apex-fused Ln5O6 trigonal bipyramids

synthesis.procedure: Calixarene 1 and 1 equiv of the dysprosium salt were dissolved in ethanol or 1:1 ethanol:ethyl acetate. Aqueous 1 M ammonium acetate was added, and the solution was evaporated under ambient conditions to give crystals of the Dy19 cluster after 1–2 weeks. The quality of the dysprosium systems was consistent under the conditions explored; Dy19-B is the form discussed in detail. Metal:calixarene ratios of 2:1 to 1:3 still deposited Dy19 clusters.

reagents.name: bis-tetrazole calixarene 1
reagents.amount: 1 equiv relative to metal (standard); ratios 2:1, 1:1, 1:2, 1:3 also explored

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals of sufficient quality for single-crystal X-ray diffraction deposited after 1–2 weeks.

properties.summary: Dy19-B shows χMT close to 19 uncoupled Dy(III) ions at room temperature, a decrease on cooling then a sharp rise below 13 K consistent with ferromagnetic interactions, nonsaturating magnetization from anisotropy, and frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility below 8 K consistent with SMM behavior with low blocking temperature (TB < 1.8 K; no hysteresis at ≥1.8 K).

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: 2 K; 100 Oe; rise attributed to ferromagnetic interactions

measurements.name: magnetization M
measurements.conditions: high field, nonsaturating; M vs H/T not superimposable below 35 K; compared with 19 × 5.80 μB

measurements.name: out-of-phase ac susceptibility χ″
measurements.value: frequency-dependent signal below 8 K; no χ″ maximum

measurements.name: blocking temperature TB
measurements.conditions: no magnetization hysteresis at or above 1.8 K; SMM-like ac response

source_locations.location: structure discussion of Dy19-B after Figure 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: dysprosium bottlebrush cluster Dy19-C (trigonal crystal form)
list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: [Dy19(1-3H)(1-2H)11(CH3CO2)6(OH)26(H2O)30] (core formulation shared with Dy19 series; packing variant obtained with increased acetate)

material_class.structural_family: rod-like bottlebrush cluster of apex-fused Ln5O6 trigonal bipyramids

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to the other Dy19 forms from calixarene 1, 1 equiv lanthanoid salt, and aqueous 1 M ammonium acetate in ethanol or 1:1 ethanol:ethyl acetate with ambient evaporation (1–2 weeks). Increasing the relative amount of acetate did not yield a smaller cluster but altered the packing of the cluster in the crystal (Dy19-C).

reagents.name: ammonium acetate
reagents.role: carboxylate coligand; increased relative amount used to obtain this packing form
reagents.amount: 1 M aqueous solution; increased relative amount vs standard Dy19 preparations

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals of the trigonal Dy19-C packing form deposited upon evaporation; packing details referred to SI.

properties.summary: No separate magnetic or optical data are reported for Dy19-C; magnetic studies focus on Dy19-B.

source_locations.location: structure discussion (two monoclinic Dy19-A/B and one trigonal Dy19-C)

material_class.structural_family: shorter rod-like bottlebrush cluster of apex-fused Ln5O6 trigonal bipyramids

synthesis.procedure: Substituting acetate with benzoate under otherwise related conditions gave a smaller Ln12 cluster. Crystals of the dysprosium complex Dy-12 formed readily from 1:1 ethanol:ethyl acetate solutions. The same trigonal-bipyramidal core motif is retained but shortened, with benzoate/water at one terminus.

reagents.name: bis-tetrazole calixarene 1
reagents.amount: used in the same general protocol as Dy19 (metal:calixarene combinations explored as 2:1 to 1:3 for related acetate chemistry)

reagents.name: dysprosium metal salt
reagents.amount: 1 equiv relative to calixarene in the general protocol

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals formed readily from 1:1 ethanol:ethyl acetate solutions and were used for structure determination.

properties.summary: Dy12 shows χMT near 12 uncoupled Dy(III) ions at room temperature, non-superimposable M vs H/T plots and a nonsaturating high-field magnetization, plus frequency-dependent χ″ below 8 K consistent with SMM behavior and TB < 1.8 K (no hysteresis ≥1.8 K).

measurements.conditions: high field, nonsaturating; ~12 × 5.80 μB; M vs H/T non-superimposable

measurements.name: out-of-phase ac susceptibility χ″
measurements.value: significant frequency-dependent χ″ below 8 K; no χ″ maximum

measurements.conditions: no hysteretic magnetization at or above 1.8 K
